_instructions: Benchmark: a wrong check of the last answer in grounded question answering (detect_wrong_check).
The question is asked only for a turn that answer_from_material read as a reaction, after an answer from the material: does the turn repeat back a value of that answer with a different value?

id, language (en | es), description, category, trap (a case built to provoke an error: a wrong check hidden by a comment or by another form of the value, a same value in another form, a number that is not a value of the answer)

Critical cases: every wrong check (expected_wrong_check true, the categories wrong_*): read as no wrong check, it is the critical error wrong_check_missed (the misunderstanding passes, the robot only invites more questions). A case that is not a wrong check read as one is reported (false_wrong_check).
answer               : the robot's last answer, as the skill passes it (without the invitation to ask more)
expected_wrong_check : true only if the turn repeats back a value of the answer with a different value (12-hour and 24-hour times, digits and words of the same value are the same value)

Categories: wrong_plain, wrong_comment_after, wrong_comment_before (wrong checks); right_plain, right_comment, right_other_format (checks with the same value); reaction (no value); other_number (a number that is not a value of the answer).
No content from the evaluation scenarios nor from the examples of the prompts.
